in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Karolus originis Germanicae, significans 'homines liberi' vel 'proelia libera', a vocabulis Germanicis Carolus et Franks derivatum. In Ecclesia Catholicorum, nomen Karolus in memoria Imperatoris Caroli Magni, qui Imperium Romanum renovavit, celebratur. Nomen Karolus in cultu Christiani significat libertatem et virtutem in Christo Iesu.

in_english.name: Karl
in_english.meaning: a masculine given name of Germanic origin, meaning 'free men' or 'free war'
in_english.long_meaning: The name Karl is a masculine given name of Germanic origin, meaning 'free men' or 'free war', derived from the Old High German words karl and hari. In Christian tradition, the name Karl is associated with Saint Charles Borromeo, a 16th-century Italian cardinal who championed Catholic reform. The name Karl represents freedom, courage, and strength in Christ. It is a popular name in many Christian cultures, symbolizing the qualities of a faithful and courageous follower of Christ.

saint_reference.note: Saint Charles Borromeo (1538-1584) was a 16th-century Italian cardinal who championed Catholic reform and was a strong advocate for the rights of the poor.

data.cultural_impact: The name Karl has had a significant cultural impact, with numerous renowned figures bearing this name, particularly in European history. Notable figures include Frederick II (1211-1250), Holy Roman Emperor; Carl Linnaeus (1707-1778), the father of modern taxonomy; and Karl Marx (1818-1883), the philosopher and economist who significantly influenced modern Communism. The name's association with esteemed leaders, scholars, and thinkers has given it a rich and enduring reputation within European culture.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Karl can be traced back to the Proto-Germanic word "karl," meaning "man" or "free man." From a spiritual perspective, this name conveys the idea of personal liberation and human dignity. It reflects the belief in the worth and power of each individual to live according to their own values and choices. Thus, the name Karl can be seen as a meaningful reminder of the inherent worth and spiritual potential within each person.
